## About
Joe Nolan was born and raised in Fullerton and found his love for cars in Auto Shop at Fullerton High School. He started out as an apprentice at a local independent garage, and later he and his wife bought the shop on Williamson Ave where he has served customers ever since.
Joe is an ASE Certified Master Technician who keeps up with training every year. The shop is founded on honesty and integrity, and the goal is simple: keep your vehicle safely on the road, fix it in a timely manner, and charge a fair price. Whether it's the family car or a company fleet, we'd be honored to take care of it.
Neighbors have rated us 5 on Google from 416 reviews, and a lot of our work comes from customers telling family and friends.

## Services
- Foreign and domestic repair: Quick, accurate diagnosis and repair on foreign and domestic cars, trucks and SUVs.
- Check engine light scan: Check engine light on? We currently offer a free check engine light scan. (Free)
- Oil, lube and filter: Routine oil, lube and filter service to keep your car running right.
- AC service: Keep your car cool, with a current special on AC service. ($40 off)
- Battery and electric repair: Battery and electric problems tracked down and fixed.
- Used car and pre-owned inspections: Have the car looked over before you buy it.

## FAQ
Q: What kinds of vehicles do you work on?
A: Foreign and domestic cars, trucks and SUVs.

Q: How do I schedule an appointment?
A: Call the shop or use the online appointment form. Please request appointments 48 hours in advance.

Q: Can I drop my car off after hours?
A: Yes. Fill out the vehicle drop-off form on our website and you can leave your vehicle at the shop after hours.
